description: Source code for a web scraper class 'NIHHealthyEating' that extracts recipe information from a specific website, including title, total time, yields, image, ingredients, instructions, nutrients, description, prep and cook times, serving size, recipe source, and recipe cards.

classes.name: NIHHealthyEating
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from healthyeating.nhlbi.nih.gov

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host URL for the website.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Extracts and returns the recipe title.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Returns the site name, raises exception if not available.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Calculates and returns total recipe time.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts and returns the number of servings.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Returns the URL of the recipe image.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Returns ingredient groups, possibly broken into sections.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of all ingredients.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Returns the recipe instructions as a string.

methods.name: nutrients
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of nutrient information.

methods.name: recipe_cards
methods.description: Returns a list of recipe card links and sizes.
